from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from io import StringIO
from unittest.mock import Mock,patch
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/Users/zsx/work/gitee/pkv/tests')
from integration_test import server
checks=0
for login in [None,('default','secret')]:
 for failure in [BrokenPipeError(),ConnectionResetError(),
     ConnectionRefusedError(),TimeoutError(),
     AssertionError("connection closed or invalid frame: b''")]:
  process=Mock();process.poll.side_effect=[None,1];process.returncode=1
  client=Mock();client.call.side_effect=failure
  with patch('integration_test.ports',return_value=27345), \
       patch('integration_test.subprocess.Popen',return_value=process), \
       patch('integration_test.Client',return_value=client), \
       patch('integration_test.time.sleep'),redirect_stdout(StringIO()):
   try:
    with server('/unused/pkv',login=login):
     raise RuntimeError('Rejected server incorrectly yielded readiness')
   except AssertionError as error:
    assert str(error)=='server exited with 1',repr(error)
  client.close.assert_called_once();process.terminate.assert_called_once()
  process.wait.assert_called_once();checks+=1
for reply in [b'WRONG',AssertionError('invalid reply: malformed')]:
 process=Mock();process.poll.return_value=None
 client=Mock()
 if isinstance(reply,Exception):client.call.side_effect=reply
 else:client.call.return_value=reply
 with patch('integration_test.ports',return_value=27345), \
      patch('integration_test.subprocess.Popen',return_value=process), \
      patch('integration_test.Client',return_value=client), \
      patch('integration_test.time.sleep'),redirect_stdout(StringIO()):
  try:
   with server('/unused/pkv'):
    raise RuntimeError('Invalid response incorrectly yielded readiness')
  except AssertionError as error:
   assert str(error)==('invalid reply: malformed' if isinstance(reply,
       Exception) else ''),repr(error)
 client.close.assert_called_once();process.terminate.assert_called_once()
 checks+=1
process=Mock();process.poll.return_value=None
client=Mock();client.call.return_value=b'PONG'
with patch('integration_test.ports',return_value=27345), \
     patch('integration_test.subprocess.Popen',return_value=process), \
     patch('integration_test.Client',return_value=client):
 with server('/unused/pkv') as port:assert port==27345
client.close.assert_called_once();process.terminate.assert_called_once();checks+=1
print('Startup probe cases:',checks)
print('Transient startup closure observes child exit; malformed replies fail')
